entities.name: Balázs Bacskai
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Imre Balázs Bacskai is a Hungarian professional boxer who has held the WBO Inter-Continental super-welterweight title since 2020. As an amateur, he competed at the 2016 Summer Olympics in the men's welterweight event, in which he was eliminated in the round of 32 by Souleymane Cissokho.
